claims.evidence: The witness photos show used tyres only (stacked and laid out). No rims/wheels are shown, and no origin/labeling is readable.

risks.risk: Tyre size (rim diameter, width/aspect) and load/speed rating are unknown, which can make the tyres unusable or unsafe for the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the tyre sidewall showing size (e.g., 205/55R16) plus load index and speed rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyre-only, unknown size/ratings (worst-case fit/safety uncertainty).

risks.risk: Brand/model and whether all tyres match (same size/brand/model and similar wear) is unknown; mismatched sets reduce value and handling safety.
risks.proof: Side-by-side sidewall shots of all tyres showing brand/model and size, plus a photo of the full set laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a mixed/possibly non-matching set.

risks.risk: Tread depth in mm and remaining usable life are not measured; visual wear alone can hide low tread or uneven wear.
risks.proof: A photo of each tyre with a tread-depth gauge reading (mm) at multiple points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn tyres with limited remaining tread.

risks.risk: Age/production date (DOT code) is not shown; older tyres can be unsafe even if tread looks acceptable.
risks.proof: Clear DOT/production date code close-ups from at least two tyres.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tyres (age risk).

risks.risk: Damage/leak risk (cuts, bulges, punctures, repairs) and sidewall condition (cracks/dry rot) are not confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up inspection photos of sidewalls and tread for cracks, bulges, embedded objects, and any repair patches; include a photo of the valve area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres with unknown integrity (assume possible defects until inspected).

risks.risk: Seller may be implying wheels are included, but photos show tyres only; if wheels/rims are not included, value drops.
risks.proof: A photo showing the rims/wheels included (if any), or a clear statement plus photos of the full package contents.

proof_requests: Send clear sidewall photos for each tyre showing: size (e.g., 205/55R16), load index, speed rating, and brand/model.
Send DOT/production date code close-ups for at least two tyres (and ideally all).
Provide tread-depth measurements in mm for each tyre (multiple points per tyre) with a gauge visible.
Show close-ups of sidewalls and tread for cracks, dry rot, cuts, bulges, punctures, and any repairs.
Confirm whether rims/wheels are included; if yes, upload photos of the rims/wheels and their sizes/bolt pattern.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as used winter/all-season style tyres, so it can be priced at the worst case for unknown size, age, tread depth, and damage. The claim about wheels/origin is not supported by the photos.
